data.name: Frumencio
data.gender_notes: Frumencio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Frumentius, meaning 'grain, corn'. This name was given to a third-century saint who converted the Ethiopian kingdom to Christianity and was later made a bishop. The name evokes a sense of freedom and joy, representing the liberation of the Ethiopian people from spiritual darkness. The name Frumencio carries the meaning “Freedom, Joy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Frumencio usually hope their child will grow to embody freedom, joy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name inspired by the Christian saint Frumentius, symbolizing the spiritual freedom found through faith.
data.etymology: Frumencio belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Freedom, Joy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frumencio total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.long_meaning: פרומנטיו הוא שם נוצרי שמקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו האדרת האל או שובח לאל. השם נגזר מהמילה הלטינית 'frumentum', שפירושה תבואה או דגן, וייתכן כי הוא קשור למושג הרוחני של לחם האל או לחם השמיים.

in_greek.name: Φρουμέντιος
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει δοξάζοντας τον Θεό
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Φρουμέντιος είναι χριστιανικό όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό όνομα Frumentius και σημαίνει δοξάζοντας τον Θεό ή υμνώντας τον Θεό. Το όνομα πιθανόν να συνδέεται με την πνευματική έννοια του хлеба του Θεού ή του ουράνιου хлеба.
